UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile on the portfolio website.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

bio.description: A brief biography or introduction of the user.

skills.description: An array of skills possessed by the user.

contactInformation.description: Contact information for the user, such as phone number or social media links.

themePreference.description: The user's preferred theme (e.g., light, dark).

displayName.description: The user's display name, often from a social provider.

photoURL.description: The URL of the user's profile picture, often from a social provider.

Video.title: Video
Video.description: Represents an embedded video on the website.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Video entity.

embedUrl.description: The URL for embedding the video.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a comment on a video.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Comment entity.

text.description: The text content of the comment.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the comment was created.

Like.title: Like
Like.description: Represents a like on a video.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Like entity.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the like was created.

Framework.title: Framework
Framework.description: Represents a framework or project displayed in the grid layout.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Framework entity.

title.description: The title of the framework or project.

description.description: A description of the framework or project.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image representing the framework.

ContractSubmission.title: ContractSubmission
ContractSubmission.description: Represents a submission from a contract or partner form.

fullName.description: Full name of the person submitting.

projectDetails.description: Details about the project or partnership.

projectId.description: ID of the related project, if applicable.

promoCodeUses.description: Number of times the promo code has been used.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who submitted the request.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to support a portfolio website with user profiles, videos, comments, likes, and frameworks. It emphasizes authorization independence and clear security rules. User profiles are stored in `/users/{userId}`, enabling path-based ownership for private user data. Videos and frameworks are stored in root-level collections (`/videos` and `/frameworks`) as they are not directly owned by individual users and are intended to be more globally accessible. Comments and Likes are stored as subcollections under `/videos/{videoId}` to represent the 1:N relationships. This structure avoids hierarchical authorization dependencies, ensuring that rules can be written without requiring `get()` calls to parent documents. For example, comment documents include `userProfileId` to check write access control. Security rules are simplified due to the structural segregation of user-specific data and global data. List operations are secured by ensuring that only authenticated users can access certain collections (e.g., `/users`). A new `ContractSubmission` entity has been added to handle both project contracts and partner requests, differentiated by a `type` field and managed by a `status` field for partner approvals.
